sourceCopy.name: Text to Speech
sourceCopy.title: Text to Speech Free Online | UsefulVerse
sourceCopy.description: Read text aloud with a voice on your device. Free, no account, no upload to this site. Voice availability depends on your browser.
sourceCopy.intro: Turn written text into speech with a voice available in your browser or device. Choose a voice, adjust speed and pitch, then pause, resume or stop.
sourceCopy.howQuestion: How do I convert text to speech online?
sourceCopy.howAnswer: Enter or paste text, choose an available voice and press Play. You can pause, continue or stop at any time. Playback uses the speech service selected in your browser or device.
sourceCopy.privacyQuestion: Is my text uploaded or saved?
sourceCopy.privacyAnswer: This site does not upload or save your text. The text is passed to the speech service selected in your browser or device. A voice marked local may process on your device; an unknown or remote voice may send text to its provider. Read that provider’s privacy terms before choosing that voice.

fields.textPlaceholder: Type or paste up to 30,000 characters here…
fields.remoteNotice: Some voices may send text to a third-party provider. They stay hidden unless you choose to show them, and playback asks you to confirm first.
fields.privacyNote: Voice availability and processing depend on the browser, operating system and installed speech services. A “local” label is not a guarantee of how the operating system handles audio.

example.label: Load a short reading example
example.text: Try this free tool: it reads text aloud with a voice available on your device. You can change the speed, pause, continue or stop whenever you like.

additionalFaqs.question: Does this create an MP3 file?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. Browser speech synthesis plays audio but does not provide a consistent audio-file export. Use a separate recording tool only if you have permission to record the audio.

additionalFaqs.question: Why do I see no voices?
additionalFaqs.answer: Voices come from your browser and operating system. They may load after a short delay, or none may be installed for this language. Check device speech settings or try another browser.

additionalFaqs.question: Does a local voice guarantee that audio stays on my device?
additionalFaqs.answer: No. This site does not upload your text, but the browser’s local label cannot guarantee how the operating system or speech service processes audio. An unknown or remote voice may send text to its provider.
